$comment: Weapon skins (docs/17 §3.3, docs/04 §8.7). Each item is worn in its gun's loadout slot `skin_<weaponId>` and rides the look's wire ids, so everyone in a match draws it. `tier`: base (the gun as it ships, every player's default), wrap, skin, forged (a blueprint: reshaped parts in one GLB, §3.6) or forged_kill_effect (forged plus the line's kill effect, §3.7: its own wire id, so a player can wear the plain Forged skin with the effect off). Skins carry no stats and no FX parameters: `tracerTint` (the bolt) and `tracerTrail` (its path line) are hues only (V5, V7; test/weaponSkins.test.ts holds each to the base tracer's luminance ±10% and ΔE ≥ 15 from the reserved colours), and the muzzle flash stays the base's. `includes`: owning this item also unlocks those (the kill-effect tier includes its plain Forged skin). `model`: the GLB under /assets/.
